definitions.rating_norm: catalogue_score / 10 (public catalogue score; never a personal rating)
definitions.hits: count of the candidate's namespaced genre/theme tags among the profile's top-10 namespaced tags (frequency desc, ties by label asc)
definitions.genre_affinity: mean of profile frequency over the candidate's genres; NaN if candidate has none or no visible item has a genre
definitions.length_affinity: exp(-|log1p(episodes) - log1p(median visible episodes)|); NaN if unknown
definitions.max_tag_similarity: max over visible items of 0.5*Jaccard(genres) + 0.5*Jaccard(themes); empty union -> 0; NaN only for an empty history

profile: frequencies are counts over the visible history H divided by |H|
